data.raw_text:
Tinupok ng apoy ang isang bahay sa Payatas Road sa Barangay Commonwealth, Quezon City bandang 12:34 AM.

Dalawang caretaker na lang ang naninirahan sa bahay na nasa trabaho nang mangyari ang sunog.

Ayon sa may-ari ng bahay, limang taon na silang nakalipat at ipapa-renovate na sana ang bahay. Wala raw supply ng kuryente roon kaya hindi nila alam kung ano ang posibleng pinagmulan ng apoy.

Umabot sa unang alarma ang sunog na naapula matapos ang 30 minuto. Inaalam pa ng Bureau of Fire Protection ang sanhi ng apoy. | via James Agustin/GMA Integrated News

VIDEO COURTESY: John Ruiez Clavaton

data.english_translation: The fire destroyed a house at Pay milka Road in Bargay Commonwealth, Quezon City about 12:34 AM. Only two home workers who lived at work when the fire occurred. According to the owner of the house, they had moved five years earlier and had the house covered. It said that there was no electricity supply there that they didn't know what the fire might be like. The first fire alarm reached when the 30 minutes was red.
